name: scholar-workflow
description: Plan-first scholarly resource management: scope open-ended research requests and route them, import papers, archive technical documents, sync Obsidian indexes and Notion projections, build literature novelty trees, recommend daily papers from four sources with NotebookLM skim, write detailed paper analyses, scaffold a personal API-key and SSH-server env-records ledger.

paper_inbox.title: Paper download inbox
paper_inbox.description: Where downloaded PDFs land, awaiting manual import into Zotero.

research_vault_root.title: Research Obsidian vault root
research_vault_root.description: Root of the Obsidian vault (or a folder within it) where this plugin writes research projections. The plugin only touches its own folders and managed blocks; the vault may hold unrelated content.

notion_enabled.title: Enable Notion projection
notion_enabled.description: Allow plans to include metadata-only Notion projections.
